settings.hero_body: The set you stopped to count is the set you receive: eight separate plush companions, one of every pictured design. No choosing a color and hoping the rest come with it.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: A clear yes to the whole crew.
settings.final_body: Choose the complete set and leave nobody behind.
settings.moods_title: Meet every member of your set.
settings.moods_body: Count the colors. They all come home together.
settings.personality_body: Each has its own costume and personality. This is eight plushes, not one plush with interchangeable outfits.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
